_about: Disease facts used by the decision pipeline: display names, how fast each disease spreads, visual cues for follow-up questions. Treatment advice is NOT here; it comes from the sourced notes in knowledge/docs (Day 6). Sources for the facts below are listed in knowledge/docs.

potato_early_blight.name: Potato early blight
potato_early_blight.key_signs: brown spots with rings like a target, usually starting on older, lower leaves

potato_late_blight.name: Potato late blight
potato_late_blight.key_signs: large dark, water-soaked patches; white fuzzy growth under the leaf in damp weather; can destroy a field within days

tomato_bacterial_spot.name: Tomato bacterial spot
tomato_bacterial_spot.key_signs: many small, dark, greasy-looking spots, sometimes with a yellow edge; spreads with rain splash

tomato_early_blight.name: Tomato early blight
tomato_early_blight.key_signs: brown spots with rings like a target, often with a yellow area around them, starting on lower leaves

tomato_late_blight.name: Tomato late blight
tomato_late_blight.key_signs: large dark, water-soaked patches; white fuzzy growth under the leaf in damp weather; spreads very quickly

tomato_leaf_mold.name: Tomato leaf mould
tomato_leaf_mold.key_signs: pale yellow patches on top of the leaf with olive-green or grey velvety mould underneath; common in humid greenhouses

tomato_mosaic_virus.name: Tomato mosaic virus
tomato_mosaic_virus.key_signs: light and dark green mottled (patchwork) pattern, wrinkled or distorted leaves; spreads by hands, tools and seed

tomato_septoria.name: Tomato Septoria leaf spot
tomato_septoria.key_signs: many small round spots with dark borders and pale grey centres, often with tiny black dots inside

tomato_yellow_curl_virus.name: Tomato yellow leaf curl virus
tomato_yellow_curl_virus.key_signs: leaves curl upwards, yellow leaf edges, small leaves and stunted plants; whiteflies often present

follow_up_questions.question: Look closely at the spots. Which looks more like your leaf?

options.text: Bigger brown spots with rings inside, like a target
Many small round spots with dark edges and pale centres
Many tiny dark spots that look greasy or wet

follow_up_questions.question: How do the damaged areas look?

options.text: Dry brown spots with rings, mostly on older lower leaves
Large dark patches that look wet, maybe white fuzz underneath, spreading fast

follow_up_questions.question: Turn the leaf over. What do you see underneath?

options.text: Olive-green or grey velvety mould under yellow patches
White fuzzy growth at the edge of dark wet-looking patches
Light and dark green patchwork pattern, leaves wrinkled
Leaves curling upwards with yellow edges, plant looks small
Leaves look normal and evenly green

follow_up_questions.question: Are there any spots or dead (brown) areas on the leaf?

options.text: No, the leaf is evenly green
Yes, there are spots or brown areas
No spots, but yellowing, curling or a patchy pattern

extent_question.question: How much of your crop is affected?

options.text: Many leaves on one or two plants
